title: Local C^{j,alpha} classes are closed under h - (finite sum) and under modification outside U
statement: Let n, j, N be natural numbers, alpha real, E a real normed space, U an open subset of R^n, and h, g : R^n -> E and f_1, ..., f_N : R^n -> E (indexed by Fin N). Assume h and every f_i are C^j on U and their j-th derivatives (iteratedFDeriv R j) are alpha-Hoelder on every compact subset of U, and g(x) = h(x) - Σ_i f_i(x) for every x in U. Then g is C^j on U and its j-th derivative is alpha-Hoelder on every compact subset of U.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (j N : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (h g : Rn n → E) (f : Fin N → Rn n → E), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ j h U → (∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j h x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ j h y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → (∀ i : Fin N, ContDiffOn ℝ j (f i) U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f i) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f i) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → (∀ x ∈ U, g x = h x - ∑ i, f i x) → ContDiffOn ℝ j g U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ j g y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
